invariants.rationale: Method always returns a non-null iterator as it is the result of IOUtils.runMerge.
fileId is used as an argument and must be non-null for downstream methods.
instantTime is expected to be non-null, as it is passed to both getUpdateHandle and runMerge.
partitionPath is used in getUpdateHandle and should be non-null.
keyToNewRecords is used as input to merge handle and must be non-null.
